name: Zen Kaku Gothic New
summary: Specimen page of Zen Kaku Gothic New, a contemporary Japanese gothic (sans serif) family for fine typesetting.
description: Specimen page for the Zen Kaku Gothic New typeface family by Yoshimichi Ohira: a contemporary Japanese gothic (sans serif) design that gives fine typesetting without detailed manual adjustments. The family is released under the SIL Open Font License 1.1 and its character coverage includes Japanese and Cyrillic.
